content.text: {"query": "pgvector filtered query latency", "results": [{"title": "Filtered approximate nearest-neighbour search: why selectivity matters", "url": "https://github.com/pgvector/pgvector#filtering", "content": "With approximate indexes, filtering is applied after the index is scanned; when a filter matches few rows, fewer results are returned unless more of the index is searched, and latency grows."}, {"title": "Benchmarking filtered vector search at 10M vectors", "url": "https://benchmarks.example-research.org/filtered-ann-2026", "content": "Median latency ranged from 4 ms to over 300 ms depending on index type (HNSW vs IVFFlat) and on filter selectivity; low-selectivity filters needed iterative scans to keep recall."}]}

results.title: Filtered approximate nearest-neighbour search: why selectivity matters
results.content: With approximate indexes, filtering is applied after the index is scanned; when a filter matches few rows, fewer results are returned unless more of the index is searched, and latency grows.

results.title: Benchmarking filtered vector search at 10M vectors
results.content: Median latency ranged from 4 ms to over 300 ms depending on index type (HNSW vs IVFFlat) and on filter selectivity; low-selectivity filters needed iterative scans to keep recall.
